verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer is a venture-focused law firm. Its client tools (Contract Generator, GDHQ, SMART Request intake forms, the D&O portal, and the internal ChatGD) are legal-service utilities, not a platform where users build automations. Versioning, reviewing and rolling back user automations is therefore a category error for this kind of product. The evidence also shows no shipped automation-building capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
